name: Operational forecasting and allocation
description: FreshRetailNet-LT observed sales support time-aware forecasts and capacity-constrained allocation scenarios. The implementation includes a typed ingestion ledger, immutable input snapshots and asynchronous jobs. Stockout-adjusted forecasts and operating effects remain scenarios, not observed retailer savings.
methods: Time-aware features · masked-history evaluation · constrained allocation · transactional ingestion

name: Causal customer decisions
description: A 64,000-customer randomized campaign did not establish that personalized targeting beats the selected simple policy. A separate 873,520-row Criteo cohort tests released-sample response and selection sensitivity; it does not identify original-population causal profit.
methods: Randomized policy evaluation · cross-fitting · paired uncertainty · selection sensitivity

name: Bank-risk model validation
description: 237,253 annual bank observations support a purged temporal failure-monitoring study with separate calibration and policy stages. Later monitoring missed 9 of 10 failures, restricting use despite stronger earlier ranking. Bank failure is not borrower default or regulatory approval.
roles: Bank risk, model validation, risk analytics
methods: Temporal purging · rare-event calibration · model challenge · cohort monitoring

name: Corporate Finance Decision Lab
description: Nine issuer reports, a traced financial spread and a funded-growth policy model. Final extraction: 33 supported correct /36 financial targets for both methods, three justified abstentions. 519 independent valuation checks and a reconciled formula workbook.
roles: Corporate finance, FP&A, financial research and finance data
methods: Source-cell extraction · accounting identities · funded growth · reverse scenarios · Decimal reconciliation

name: Indian inflation release vintages
description: 48 official releases and 144 vintage observations. An 18-release final check retains persistence: RMSE 0.8185 pp versus 1.6901 for fixed AR(1). Release dates and the later base revision remain separate. No current inflation forecast is claimed.
roles: Economic research, time series, publication-aware data
methods: Publication-aware as-of joins · Ridge AR(1) · release revisions · block uncertainty

name: Treasury ALM and liquidity
description: Interest-rate hedging, published Treasury curves and hypothetical benefit cash flows. Four hedge policies, 56 instantaneous stresses and 108 liquidity-runoff cases. Independent Decimal and formula-workbook reconciliations support the modelling.
methods: Term-structure cash flows · constrained hedging · rate stresses · liquidity conservation

name: Insurance pricing and reserve uncertainty
description: French motor pricing and a separate US auto-reserving study. Fixed pricing comparisons and reserve interval scores expose conditional-calibration and coverage failures. The two populations are not joined.
roles: Actuarial analytics, insurance risk, uncertainty modelling
methods: Exposure-weighted GLMs · calibrated boosting · Mack covariance · interval coverage
